doc_title_en: Notification regarding policy to reduce strategic shareholdings and expected extraordinary gain from sale of strategic shareholdings
doc_title_jp: 政策保有株式の縮減方針および政策保有株式の売却に伴う特別利益計上見込みに関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 企業価値向上に向けた資本効率の更なる向上および財務体質の強化

summary_en: ~2.6B yen proceeds from sale of listed cross-holdings. Target: reduce cross-holdings to <10% of consolidated net assets by end-Mar 2030. Sale completion planned by end-Sep 2029. Proceeds to be deployed toward sustainable growth and capital efficiency. ~700M yen gain expected in FY3/27.
summary_jp: 上場有価証券の売却により約26億円。政策保有株式を連結純資産比10%未満に縮減（2030年3月末までに）。売却完了予定は2029年9月末。~7億円の売却益をFY3/27で見込む。
tag_en: Cross-holding reduction - ~2.6B yen proceeds - 10% of net assets target by Mar 2030 - Listed securities sale
